name: Aage Suno
format: ORIGINAL fiction serials in Hindi/Hinglish: one story runs about 10 parts, one part a day, every part ends on a cliffhanger (mystery thriller, emotional family drama, light horror, fantasy, karma twist, love with a secret, survival, small-town sci-fi). Never mythology, religion or real people.

voice.style: a low, calm, tense Indian male thriller narrator; unhurried and tense, about 2.6 words per second, short pauses, a suspenseful beat only before the final question; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences
voice.style_en: a low, calm, tense Indian male, clear Indian-English accent thriller narrator; unhurried and tense, about 2.6 words per second, short pauses, a suspenseful beat only before the final question; speak slightly slower than a normal fast reel, with clear pauses between sentences

visuals.look: cinematic night thriller still, rain, film grain, cold teal shadows, warm amber practical lights, Indian location
visuals.cast: one recurring narrator-detective (fixed description) + case cast

film.use: the story as it happens (default, most scenes)
film.pic: cinematic night thriller still, rain, film grain, cold teal shadows, warm amber practical lights, Indian location

cctv.use: someone is being watched, a recording, a camera, a moment seen from far away or from above
cctv.pic: grainy security camera still from a high corner angle, wide lens distortion, desaturated green-grey, low resolution noise, night, no on-screen text, no timestamp

memory.use: a memory, a flashback, the past, what someone remembers or imagines
memory.pic: faded 1990s film photograph, warm washed-out colours, soft focus, light leaks, dust and scratches, nostalgic Indian home or street

rules: fiction clearly fiction, no real crimes/people
fiction only: no mythology, gods, religion or real events

warmup.note: new accounts: profile + manual engagement 17-19 Nov, 1 reel/day (20:00) 20-26 Nov, then 2/day

serial.note: engine/serials.py plans the whole arc once (story bible), then one part per slot
